rules.name: legacy-vs-pg-objects-dev
rules.sql: SELECT table_name AS legacy_name, CASE WHEN table_type = 'VIEW' THEN 'view' ELSE 'table' END AS legacy_kind, CASE WHEN table_name REGEXP '_(alm|bkr|cfs|coc|cof|cto|ebo|gpc|grn|oad|odr|og2|ogp|orm|osg|pf6|pf9|pg7|pg8|qf1|qf2|qf3|qf4|qf5|rba|rbc|rbh|rmc|rov|spc|stg|tsy|usg)$' THEN SUBSTRING(table_name, 1, CHAR_LENGTH(table_name) - 4) ELSE table_name END AS base_name, CASE WHEN table_name REGEXP '_(alm|bkr|cfs|coc|cof|cto|ebo|gpc|grn|oad|odr|og2|ogp|orm|osg|pf6|pf9|pg7|pg8|qf1|qf2|qf3|qf4|qf5|rba|rbc|rbh|rmc|rov|spc|stg|tsy|usg)$' THEN SUBSTRING(table_name, CHAR_LENGTH(table_name) - 2) ELSE '' END AS bu, table_rows AS est_rows FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' ORDER BY base_name, table_name

SELECT c.relname AS pg_name, CASE c.relkind WHEN 'r' THEN 'table' WHEN 'p' THEN 'table' WHEN 'v' THEN 'view' WHEN 'm' THEN 'matview' END AS pg_kind, CASE WHEN c.relname ~ '_(alm|bkr|cfs|coc|cof|cto|ebo|gpc|grn|oad|odr|og2|ogp|orm|osg|pf6|pf9|pg7|pg8|qf1|qf2|qf3|qf4|qf5|rba|rbc|rbh|rmc|rov|spc|stg|tsy|usg)$' THEN left(c.relname, length(c.relname) - 4) ELSE c.relname END AS base_name, c.reltuples::bigint AS est_rows FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm') ORDER BY c.relname
SELECT p.proname AS function_name, count(*) AS overloads FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' GROUP BY p.proname ORDER BY p.proname

expect.reason: the legacy schema must hold tables and views
